title: Full Studio Membership with Soda Firing
source_quote: All kiln types: midrange electric, highfire gas, raku, and cross-draft soda
evidence_sentence: The membership page lists access to a cross-draft gas soda kiln as part of full studio membership.
summary: Join full studio membership to access a 21 cu.ft. cross-draft soda kiln with 60+ hours of open studio time per week. Members pay $150/month (1-month), $140/month (6-month auto-pay), or $135/month (12-month auto-pay).
how_to_join: Take a ceramics class at SCC or demonstrate prior studio experience, then schedule a required studio tour before enrollment.
pay_text: Month-to-month or commit to longer and pay less
